insights.topic: Verified purchase signal vs. probabilistic targeting
insights.insight: The protocol has confirmed 18,331 cryptographically verified purchase receipts totaling $1.13M in GMV — each receipt is a deterministic proof of transaction, not an inferred intent signal. For marketers paying $5+ CPM to reach people who might buy, this is a structurally different data layer.

insights.topic: AI and digital commerce now verifiable
insights.insight: A single May 2 event doubled the DKIM vendor allowlist to 20, adding Anthropic, OpenAI, Stripe, Paddle, Gumroad, and Suno — extending verified receipt coverage from physical retail into SaaS, AI subscriptions, and creator platforms. No throughput from these vendors has appeared in the 14-day window yet, meaning the category signal is supply-side infrastructure, not live audience data.

15 distinct active categories are now generating verified receipts, with category entropy at a record 3.149 bits — grocery, dining, department stores, gas/convenience, and an uncategorized cohort of 310 receipts ($17,485) that likely represents newly onboarded merchant types. Breadth is expanding faster than classification is keeping up.

Walmart, Costco, and Target account for the top three brand slots in the 14-day window, anchoring verified purchase identity squarely in high-frequency, high-basket physical retail — the same audience segments that are most exposed to cookie deprecation in CPG and FMCG targeting.

Velocity has held 0.60–0.65x for six consecutive measurement intervals and acceleration is oscillating at 0.999x–1.001x — the network is decelerating into a stable floor, adding receipts in modest consistent pulses rather than spiking or dropping out. For marketers evaluating the data asset, this indicates a durable low-growth state, not a signal in decline.

insights.topic: Geographic diffusion reaching full coverage bursts
insights.insight: The May 2 geographic pulse hit 100% diffusion rate across 23 CBSAs in a single heartbeat — the largest single-period expansion recorded. Combined with 29 active metros at peak, the verified receipt footprint now spans enough geography to support national audience construction, not just local pilots.
